tools.name: list_docs_sources
tools.description: List the configured Learnosity documentation sources. Use this tool or learnosity://sources/index to discover valid source ids before searching or reading.

tools.name: search_docs_sources
tools.description: Search cached Learnosity documentation sources. Use list_docs_sources or learnosity://sources/index to discover valid source ids. If no sources are provided, the search spans every configured source. Hits that touch a lower-level API outside the golden path are withheld unless off_golden_path_reason

tools.name: list_docs_categories
tools.description: List cached Learnosity categories. Use list_docs_sources or learnosity://sources/index to discover valid source ids. If no source is provided, categories from every configured source are returned.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a cached Learnosity document from a required source and article id. Use list_docs_sources or learnosity://sources/index to discover valid source ids.

tools.name: skills_list
tools.description: List Learnosity integration skills with ids, titles, goals, and APIs

tools.name: skills_read
tools.description: Read one Learnosity integration skill by id and return its Markdown body

tools.name: skills_search
tools.description: Search Learnosity integration skills by id, title, goal, APIs, or body content

tools.name: get_feedback_link
tools.description: Call this when a user wants to give feedback, report a problem, or suggest an improvement about the Learnosity MCP server or its documentation. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_feedback_link" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Call this when a user wants to give feedback, report a problem, or suggest an improvement about the Learnosity MCP server or its documentation. Returns a friend…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "build-aide" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feedback_link · Private data: read_document, get_feedback_link · Public sink: get_feedback_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feedback_link · Private data: read_document, get_feedback_link · Public sink: get_feedback_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
